intro: Bankatlal Badruka College and St Pious X College both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded MSc fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹33,800 a year as tuition fees for Bankatlal Badruka College's Master of Science(M.Sc.) Statistics. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹33,800 a year as tuition fees for St Pious X College's Master of Science(M.Sc.) Organic Chemistry. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

In our records, St Pious X College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for Master of Science(M.Sc.) Organic Chemistry. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
